question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots such as `memory.recall`, `memory.capture`, `memory.compaction`, `memory.dreaming`, and `memory.userModel` as public core config/plugin API, using https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path?
rationale: Current main still has one exclusive memory slot, but changing it adds durable public config/API surface, migration behavior, and per-agent semantics that automation should not decide.

options.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the taxonomy first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design work and ask the implementation to reduce, rename, or stage the role slots before public config surface lands.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide memory composition should stay outside core or use a different plugin API shape.

recommendation.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation candidate and decide taxonomy, compatibility, and proof there before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public OpenClaw config/plugin API direction decision, and steipete is both the listed project decision owner and a central config/plugin-slot history owner.
